qc.label_under_test: A piece inside a longer compound or proper name, in prose or code (Collegeville, S_ERROR, "#timestamp"), where the name is still being assembled; the '#' alone is not the trigger

neighbours.label: The piece that tells one member of a series of near-identical names, codes or numbers from its siblings (UVW1 vs UVW2, Afonso II vs III, FE, FS, PE, SE); an ordinary word split into pieces is not the trigger
